---
name: provenance-check
description: Check Ventura Awesome references and any adapted descriptions for accurate attribution ownership and license boundaries. Use when external lists text or assets influence the collection. Do not use when the change only adds an original short link annotation.
---

# Provenance check

- Identify external lists descriptions code or assets influencing the change.
- Distinguish link-only references from copied or adapted content.
- Read `PROVENANCE.md` when present and keep it aligned.
- Preserve required attribution and license terms for derived material.
- Prefer original short descriptions over copied upstream prose.
- Remove unsupported affiliation certification or ownership implications.
